# speckit-constitution

Use to review, check, or amend the constitution.

## Instructions

1. Read `.specify/templates/commands/constitution.md` and `.specify/memory/constitution.md`.
2. For review, show current principles and governance.
3. For compliance, check the proposal against each principle.
4. For amendments, apply the right SemVer bump and record the amendment entry.
